_about: Stubs: parts A9 has defined (layer, faces, attach points, price) and not built. `kind` is 'stub', so a stub can't be picked from the Build list and says 'Not built yet.' when placed by hand. The track named in `track` fills one in by giving it a real kind and behaviour and dropping `stub` and `track`. Prices are placeholders until A10. See logistics.json for the format. Exterior parts plug into a base's socket; lines carry an `inventory`; the Hookups declare `attach` points for joints.

modules.name: Spout
modules.blurb: Plugs into a base's side socket and pours the base's contents out of its mouth as loose pixels, a few cells a scan, for a little power a cell. Joined at its mouth to a Chute or Tank it passes them in there. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach.

modules.name: Vacuum
modules.blurb: Plugs into a base's side socket and pulls the loose pixels (powder, liquid, gas) of a wide patch in front of its mouth into the base, nearest row first, for a little power a cell. The quick way to gather whatever lies about; the Drone Cage is the slow one that takes a single material. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach.

modules.name: Energy Port
modules.blurb: Plugs into a base's side socket and is where a Cable ends. An assembly with a Node or the Hub in reach, joined by a live Cable to another assembly's Energy Port, puts that one in reach of the network too.

modules.name: Pipe Hookup
modules.blurb: Plugs into a base's side socket and is where a Pipe ends: a Pipe takes from, or puts into, the base behind its hookup.

modules.name: Anchor Hookup
modules.blurb: Plugs into a base's side socket and gives a Strut or a Rope a place to be held: click near its anchor point with the line tool and the line ends there, held to the base.

modules.name: Pipe Router
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. A junction with three Pipe ends: Pipes that end at it put what they carry into it, Pipes that start at it draw from it and share its stock, so it merges and splits.

modules.name: Pipe
modules.blurb: A line that carries pixels from one Pipe Hookup (or Pipe Router) to another: it takes from the base behind its start and puts into the base behind its end, up to 30 cells a scan. Click it to run it the other way. 1 Stone for every 10 cells, up to 100 long.

modules.name: Cable
modules.blurb: A line that carries power from one Energy Port to another. It holds some of the Hub's power while it is laid (a twentieth of a unit a cell) and, once half full, puts the assembly at its far end in the network's reach. 1 Stone for every 10 cells, up to 100 long.

modules.name: Network line
modules.blurb: A line that carries goods from a Network port (a Funnel or a Bus Hopper) outside the network's reach to one inside it, which banks them. The far port needs a Node or the Hub in reach. 2 Stone for every 20 cells, up to 120 long.
